items.q: A painless indurated genital ulcer with a button-like base and shotty nodes appearing three weeks after exposure is?
items.exp: Hunterian chancre is a single painless indurated ulcer with painless nodes, teeming with treponemes on dark-ground.
r: Incorrect. That is painful with ragged edges.
Incorrect. That gives multiple painful vesicles.
Incorrect. That gives painful oral-genital ulcers.
Correct. Painless indurated chancre.

items.q: Palmoplantar scaly papules with condyloma lata and moth-eaten alopecia weeks after a healed ulcer indicate?
items.exp: Secondary syphilis disseminates with palmoplantar lesions, moist condyloma lata and patchy alopecia.
r: Incorrect. That favours wrists with striae.
Incorrect. That favours extensors with Auspitz.
Correct. Palms-soles plus condyloma lata.
Incorrect. That spares palms with herald patch.
items.kp: Palms-soles plus condyloma lata is secondary syphilis.

items.q: A VDRL-positive antenatal screen with negative TPHA most likely represents?
items.exp: Non-treponemal tests cross-react in pregnancy and infections; treponemal confirmation is needed before labelling syphilis.
r: Incorrect. That needs CSF study.
Correct. Screen needs treponemal confirmation.
Incorrect. Confirmation needs TPHA positivity.
Incorrect. Treated past disease keeps TPHA positive.

items.q: Lightning pains, Argyll Robertson pupils and loss of joint position sense years after infection define?
items.exp: Tabes is late neurosyphilis of dorsal columns with shooting pains, pupils accommodating but not reacting, and sensory ataxia.
r: Correct. Dorsal-column late disease.
Incorrect. That gives dementia with tremor.
Incorrect. That gives strokes in young adults.
Incorrect. That gives Hutchinson teeth.
items.kp: Lightning pains with AR pupils is tabes.

items.q: A child has Hutchinson incisors, mulberry molars and sabre tibiae. These stigmata belong to?
items.exp: Late congenital stigmata include notched incisors, mulberry molars, sabre shins and Clutton joints.
r: Incorrect. That bows legs with rachitic rosary.
Incorrect. That gives cataract and deafness.
Incorrect. That gives chipmunk facies.
Correct. Classic late congenital triad.
items.kp: Notched teeth with sabre shins is congenital syphilis.

items.q: A painful soft genital ulcer with ragged undermined edges that bleeds easily plus a unilocular bubo suggests?
items.exp: Chancroid is Haemophilus ducreyi soft sore: painful, friable, with painful bubo showing school-of-fish bacilli.
r: Incorrect. LGV gives groove-sign nodes.
Incorrect. That gives beefy painless ulcers.
Correct. Painful soft sore with bubo.
Incorrect. Chancre is painless and indurated.
items.kp: Painful soft sore with bubo is chancroid.

items.q: Inguinal nodes split above and below the inguinal ligament creating parallel folds. This groove sign occurs in?
items.exp: LGV buboes straddle the ligament making the groove of Greenblatt, from C. trachomatis L1-L3 serovars.
r: Incorrect. That gives cold sinuses.
Correct. Groove sign is LGV.
Incorrect. That gives a single unilocular bubo.
Incorrect. That gives pseudobuboes.

items.q: A painless beefy-red genital ulcer that bleeds on touch with rolled edges and subcutaneous pseudobuboes is?
items.exp: Granuloma inguinale shows beefy ulcers with Donovan bodies (safety-pin Klebsiella granulomatis) in macrophages.
r: Correct. Beefy ulcer with Donovan bodies.
Incorrect. That is painful and friable.
Incorrect. Chancre is indurated, not beefy.
Incorrect. That ulcerates mouth and genitalia painfully.

items.q: Profuse purulent urethral discharge with intracellular gram-negative diplococci inside neutrophils indicates?
items.exp: Gonorrhoea shows kidney-bean intracellular diplococci within polymorphs on Gram stain of discharge.
r: Incorrect. That shows scanty discharge without diplococci.
Incorrect. That shows motile pear flagellates.
Incorrect. That shows curdy plaques with itch.
Correct. Intracellular diplococci are gonococci.

items.q: A syndromic urethral-discharge case with no microscope available is best managed by?
o: Covering gonorrhoea plus chlamydia per syndromic kit with partner therapy
items.exp: Syndromic management covers both gonococcal and non-gonococcal urethritis together with partner notification.
r: Incorrect. Steroids worsen infection.
Incorrect. Discharge needs antimicrobial cover.
Correct. Dual cover plus partner care.
Incorrect. Fungi do not cause purulent urethritis.
items.kp: No lab means dual syndromic cover.
